zh.heroKicker: 交通系统韧性与可靠性研究
zh.heroSub: 聚焦极端气候与强干扰下的交通系统
zh.heroLede: 专注交通系统韧性与可靠性研究，融合复杂网络建模、大数据挖掘与深度学习，探索极端气候与强干扰下的交通网络演化机理与应急保障策略。
zh.researchSub: 韧性 · 可靠性 · 运营 · 数据 · 应急

en.heroLede: An academic space for transportation system resilience and reliability, combining complex network modeling, big-data mining and deep learning to study network evolution and emergency response under extreme climate and severe disruptions.

about.zh: 这里是一个专注于交通系统韧性与可靠性研究的学术空间。我们立足于现代交通系统面临的安全与可持续挑战，致力于探究极端气候与强干扰事件下的交通网络演化机理与应急保障策略。建设本网站的目的，不仅是为了展示团队主持欧盟“玛丽·居里学者”项目、国家自然科学基金等前沿课题的研究进展，更是希望搭建一个开放的知识共享平台。在这里，我们将系统分享自身的最新学术成果，同时也会持续追踪并分享相关领域内的突破性新发现与优秀科研成果，期望能借此与同行学者及感兴趣的读者共同探讨交通系统发展的新理论与新技术。在研究范式上，我们高度重视“交通+数据科学”的深度交叉融合，广泛运用复杂网络建模、大数据挖掘以及深度学习等前沿技术解决实际工程问题。因此，我们不仅欢迎交通工程专业的同学，也极其期待数学、计算机科学、统计学等理工科背景的英才加入。扎实的建模计算能力与数据分析基础，是团队不断突破创新的核心驱动力。多学科的碰撞不仅能为交通韧性研究注入新活力，也有助于我们在浩瀚的科研文献中敏锐捕捉更多有价值的交叉领域新发现。团队始终致力于营造开放、包容且充满活力的学术环境。导师年轻有为，秉持扁平化的管理与指导理念，内部沟通顺畅且毫无距离感，无论是学术探讨还是进度交流，大家都能在轻松的氛围中大胆表达想法、共同攻克难题。在人才培养方面，我们不仅注重通过前沿科研项目锤炼学生数据分析与网络建模的硬核技能，更依托广泛的国际合作关系，为成员提供丰富的海外交流与深造读博资源。我们真诚期待那些愿意扎实积累、渴望真正成长的同学加入，与我们一同在这个平台上分享新知、交流思想，在交通系统韧性领域探索未知、创造价值。
about.en: This is an academic space dedicated to the study of transportation system resilience and reliability. Grounded in the safety and sustainability challenges facing modern transportation systems, we focus on understanding the evolution mechanisms of transportation networks and developing emergency response strategies under extreme climate conditions and severe disruptions. The purpose of establishing this website is not only to showcase research progress from our team's leading projects—including the European Union's Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions and the National Natural Science Foundation of China—but also to build an open platform for knowledge sharing. Here, we systematically share our latest academic achievements while continuously tracking and disseminating groundbreaking discoveries and outstanding research outcomes from related fields, aiming to engage fellow scholars and interested readers in exploring new theories and technologies for transportation system development. In terms of research methodology, we place strong emphasis on the deep integration of transportation and data science, leveraging complex network modeling, big-data mining, and deep learning to address real-world engineering challenges. Therefore, we warmly welcome students majoring in transportation engineering, as well as talented individuals with backgrounds in mathematics, computer science, statistics, and other STEM disciplines. Solid skills in modeling, computation, and data analysis serve as the core driving force behind our team's continuous innovation. Interdisciplinary collaboration not only infuses fresh vitality into resilience research but also enables us to keenly identify valuable cross-disciplinary breakthroughs within the vast scientific literature. Our team is committed to fostering an open, inclusive, and dynamic academic environment. Our mentors are young and accomplished, embracing a flat management and mentoring philosophy that ensures smooth, barrier-free communication. Whether discussing academic ideas or project progress, everyone feels comfortable expressing thoughts freely and working together to overcome challenges in a relaxed atmosphere. In talent development, we emphasize not only honing students' core competencies in data analysis and network modeling through cutting-edge research projects, but also providing abundant opportunities for overseas exchange and doctoral studies through extensive international collaborations. We sincerely invite those who are willing to work diligently and aspire to genuine growth to join us—share knowledge, exchange ideas, explore the unknown, and create value together in the field of transportation system resilience.

zh.title: 交通韧性与可靠性
zh.sub: 系统韧性与可靠性评估
zh.desc: 探究极端气候（暴雨、高温、寒潮、台风）、地震滑坡等地质灾害与强干扰事件下交通网络的演化机理，评估系统韧性与可靠度，兼顾节假日峰值客流等常态压力。

en.title: Transportation Resilience & Reliability
en.desc: Study network evolution under extreme climate (rainstorms, heatwaves, cold waves, typhoons), geohazards (earthquakes, landslides) and severe disruptions; assess resilience and reliability, including holiday peak crowds.

zh.title: 交通运营管理
zh.desc: 面向日常运营与春节、黄金周等节假日潮汐式大客流，优化通行组织、运力调度与客流疏导，提升供需匹配与网络承载弹性。

en.title: Transportation Operation Management
en.desc: Optimize traffic organization, capacity dispatch and crowd diversion for daily operations and tidal holiday peaks (Spring Festival, golden weeks), improving supply-demand matching and load elasticity.

zh.title: 大数据挖掘与运用
zh.desc: 广泛运用复杂网络建模、大数据挖掘与深度学习，从多模态交通数据中识别规律、支撑韧性评估与调度决策。

en.title: Big Data Mining & Application
en.desc: Apply complex network modeling, big-data mining and deep learning to extract patterns from multimodal traffic data and support resilience assessment and dispatching decisions.

zh.title: 灾害应急管理
zh.desc: 面向极端气候、地质灾害与突发中断，开展级联失效预警、应急保障与抢通恢复，缩短系统停运时间。

en.title: Disaster Emergency Management
en.desc: Provide cascading-failure early warning, emergency response and clearance recovery under climate extremes, geohazards and sudden disruptions to cut system downtime.

zh.title: 社会可持续性
zh.sub: 可持续发展与国际合作
zh.desc: 立足交通系统安全与可持续挑战，建设开放共享的知识平台，依托国际合作培养交通与数理统计交叉学科人才。

en.title: Social Sustainability
en.desc: Address safety and sustainability challenges of transport, build an open knowledge-sharing platform, and nurture interdisciplinary talent across transport, mathematics, computer science and statistics through international collaboration.

researchLead.zh: 围绕 交通系统韧性与可靠性，团队覆盖韧性评估、运营管理、数据挖掘、灾害应急与社会可持续五个方向，并延伸至极端气候、地质灾害与节假日峰值等典型场景。
researchLead.en: Centered on transportation resilience and reliability, the team covers resilience assessment, operation management, data mining, disaster emergency management and social sustainability, extending to extreme climate, geohazard and holiday-peak scenarios.
